# <zbk-menu-item>

One command in an action menu. The internal button remains in the menu's
roving traversal even when unavailable, using aria-disabled instead of the
native disabled attribute so keyboard users can discover the command.

Base class: `.zbk-menu-item`. Variant classes: `.zbk-menu-item--{variant}`. Tokens: `--zbk-menu-item-{property}[-{state}]`. Write `aria-*`/`role` on the element; they relocate to the internal native element. `focus()` forwards to the internal focusable.

## When to use

- A command belongs in a zbk-menu action list.
- NOT The item navigates to a destination. → zbk-link
- NOT The item represents selectable form state. → zbk-select

## Guidance

- Use menu items only as direct children of zbk-menu.
- Listen for the native bubbling click; there is no Zebkit activation event.
- Disabled items remain focusable through menu traversal so their availability is discoverable.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Unavailable but discoverable: blocks activation without leaving roving focus. |
| `variant` | `string` | `""` | Space-separated registered variant names, e.g. "ghost lg". Unknown names warn with the registered vocabulary. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| *(default)* | Visible and accessible command label. | required |
| `icon` | Presentational icon rendered before the command label. | aria-hidden; sized by `icon-size`; colored by `icon-ink` |

- `icon`: Repeat any meaning carried by the icon in the command label.

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — Native button activation bubbles a click; the owning menu closes and returns focus to its trigger.

## Events

No custom events. Native events (`click`, `change`, `input`, ...) bubble from the internal native element in light DOM — listen on the zebkit element.

## Examples

**Command**

```html
<zbk-menu><zbk-button slot="trigger">Actions</zbk-button><zbk-menu-item>Duplicate</zbk-menu-item></zbk-menu>
```

**Critical command**

```html
<zbk-menu><zbk-button slot="trigger">Actions</zbk-button><zbk-menu-item variant="critical">Delete</zbk-menu-item></zbk-menu>
```

**Unavailable command**

```html
<zbk-menu><zbk-button slot="trigger">Actions</zbk-button><zbk-menu-item disabled>Restore</zbk-menu-item></zbk-menu>
```

The command is announced as unavailable but remains discoverable during arrow-key traversal.

## Tokens (CSS custom properties)

Values are alias references (`{family.name}` compiles to `var(--zbk-family-name)`) or structural literals. Override any of them on a selector to re-style; nothing else is needed.

| Token | Default | Type | Condition | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--zbk-menu-item-display` | `block` | display | — | Display mode for each menu-item host. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-canvas` | `{color.global-transparent}` | color | — | Default command background. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-canvas-hover` | `{app.canvas-subtle}` | color | — | Command background on hover. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-canvas-active` | `{app.canvas-muted}` | color | — | Command background while pressed. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-canvas-focus` | `{app.canvas-subtle}` | color | — | Command background while roving focus rests on it. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-canvas-disabled` | `{color.global-transparent}` | color | — | Unavailable command background. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-ink` | `{app.ink}` | color | — | Default command label color. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-ink-hover` | `{app.ink-emphasis}` | color | — | Command label color on hover. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-ink-disabled` | `{disabled.ink}` | color | — | Unavailable command label color. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-icon-size` | `1em` | cssDimension | — | Size of presentational icon content. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-icon-ink` | `{app.ink-muted}` | color | — | Color inherited by icon content. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-gap` | `{spacing.sm}` | dimension | — | Space between the icon and command label. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-padding-inline` | `{spacing.sm}` | dimension | — | Inline padding inside each command. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-padding-block` | `{spacing.xs}` | dimension | — | Block padding inside each command. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-border-radius` | `{border.radius-sm}` | dimension | — | Command corner radius. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-min-height` | `44px` | dimension | — | Minimum command height for a reliable pointer target. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-font-family` | `{font-family.interface}` | fontFamily | — | Command label font family. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-font-size` | `{font-size.sm}` | cssDimension | — | Command label font size. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-font-weight` | `{font-weight.normal}` | fontWeight | — | Command label font weight. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-line-height` | `{line-height.2}` | number | — | Command label line height. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-focus-color` | `{focus.color}` | color | — | High-contrast outline color for keyboard focus. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-focus-width` | `{focus.width}` | dimension | — | High-contrast outline width for keyboard focus. |
| `--zbk-menu-item-focus-offset` | `{focus.offset}` | dimension | — | High-contrast outline offset for keyboard focus. |

| `--zbk-menu-item-transition-timing-function` | `{transition.calm-fx-function-default}` | cubicBezier | — | Easing for command state transitions. |

## Variants

A variant is a named, partial remapping of the token surface compiled to a class. Apply via `variant="name other-name"`; different axes compose, same-axis variants are alternatives.

| Variant | Axis | Class | Description | Overrides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `critical` | status | `zbk-menu-item--critical` | Critical command ink and hover treatment. | ink: {critical.ink}; ink-hover: {critical.ink-emphasis}; canvas-hover: {critical.canvas-subtle}; icon-ink: {critical.ink} |

Custom variants: add a `zbk-menu-item.variants.json` file to the base theme's token folder (component-keyed map of `{ "menu-item": { "{name}": { "overrides": { ... } } } }`; token keys must exist in the table above, values are alias references or structural literals). A shipped variant name patches that variant's CSS — usable immediately. A new name compiles a new `.zbk-menu-item--{name}` class and additionally needs `ZebkitElement.registerVariants(json)` before elements upgrade so `variant="{name}"` validates and applies it.

Related: `<zbk-menu>`, `<zbk-button>`.
